entry.author: City Rail Link
entry.summary:
Tēnā koe,
We’re powering into the final stages of the City Rail Link.

Go deep underground as we put the CRL through its final paces. First, One New Zealand CEO Jason Paris and One New Zealand Warriors CEO Cameron George put the new high-speed 4G and 5G network to the test, proving your connection won’t miss a beat from platform to tunnel and back again.Then take the ride of a lifetime on Aotearoa New Zealand’s longest escalator - a 43-metre journey down into Karanga-a-Hape Station.

And finally, join accessibility advocate Vivian as she takes part in a live emergency exercise, helping ensure every future journey is safe, inclusive and fully supported.

From seamless connectivity to world-class accessibility and rigorous safety testing, the City Rail Link is getting ready for opening day.

Come and see what’s waiting beneath Auckland.

Enjoy.
